item.title: misty-step/aesthetic v0.25.0
item.description:
New Features

  • Base UI integration support: Added anatomy adapter that enables native styling of shadcn/ui and Radix Base UI components through aesthetic.css, with documented portal layering contract and registry validation.

Improvements

  • Enhanced adoption documentation with five distinct strategies for integrating shadcn/Base UI components, from theme-only CSS variable mappings to full registry distribution approaches.

  • Design exploration lab now includes comprehensive Base UI futures catalog with responsive testing across light/dark modes and multiple viewport sizes.

  • Updated installation snippets and build workflows with improved release automation and dependency pinning.

item.title: misty-step/aesthetic v2.18.1
item.description:
New Features
  • Named theme system now available over the shared token contract, enabling consistent theming across your application with predefined color schemes and styling variants.

Bug Fixes

  • Site scaffold generator no longer overwrites existing DESIGN.md files, preventing accidental loss of documentation.
  • Gallery component image cropping now displays properly across all viewport sizes.
  • Mobile navigation spacing issues resolved, eliminating visual crowding on smaller screens.

item.title: misty-step/aesthetic v2.8.0
item.description:
New Features
  • You can now reference all design tokens programmatically through the generated tokens.json file and browse them on the new token reference page
  • You can now access interactive state matrices for all catalog primitives, showing hover, focus, disabled, and validation states
  • You can now search the component catalog client-side for faster primitive discovery
  • You can now integrate with the machine composition feed to automatically adopt design system updates in your tooling

Improvements

  • The catalog source blocks now include copy-to-clipboard functionality for easier code integration
